authorship: AI-authored analytical primary-text review; not human verified.
scope: Twelve Section 2 source-defined risk categories, using category overview on printed pages 4–5 and subsections 2.1–2.12 on pages 5–12. Section 3 introduction governs the distinction from suggested actions.

Scientific examples and literature citations as separate obligations.

unresolved_issues: The 211 action records must preserve source context: not every action applies to every actor; actor-task labels belong to a subcategory, not universally to each listed action.
Existing complete extraction status is historical bounded extraction status; it does not certify completion of the current Stage 3 review.
Do not infer current copyright or other legal duties from the Profile’s historical descriptive examples.
schema_representation_limits: Definitional EXTREQs can contextualize risk analysis but must remain distinguishable from independently operative controls.
taxonomy_gap_review: Disparate service performance, statistical fairness and representational harms are not fully captured by authority, provenance or epistemic assurance invariants merely because those domains may contribute.
Routine compute/energy/water footprint assessment differs from the existing biospheric constraint-preservation invariant; that invariant does not alone establish resource-accounting coverage.
Risk definitions do not justify adding a Fidelity Class without a separately supported invariant-level gap review.

section_3_lexical_comparison.method: Direct PDF table-cell reconstruction, uniquely aligned by source action identity; punctuation/layout/hyphenation normalization only. Raw GV4.3--001 spelling preserved for the added record.
